name: WAW-TACE (HCC multiphase CT, Warsaw)
what: WAW-TACE, multiphase abdominal CT of 233 patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, from Warsaw, Zenodo record 12741586; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 854 scans in the release's four CT archives, of which the data platform counts 228 CTs, about 47.15 GB in the catalogue (NIfTI); it is the Medical University of Warsaw part of PanTSMini
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: not recorded: the fetch took the four CT archives alone
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh zenodo --collection waw_tace --record 12741586 --include '^ct_scans_[1-4]_4_wawtace.*\.zip$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 4 CT zips by md5 and 854 _scan.nii.gz to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid waw_tace; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="waw_tace",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
